# pvecli ceph set

Set Ceph OSD flags (same as 'ceph osd set', through the API).

```text
pvecli ceph set FLAGS [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `FLAGS` | Flag(s), comma separated: noout,nobackfill. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
